description: Verified public Baghewala well registry. Only fields supported by sources are populated; everything else is null. Conflicts retained per well.

wells.notes: Discovery well (1991). Among 5 wells tested 1991-94; well 1 & 4 described as good heavy-oil producers before high viscosity/poor inflow halted production. Current operating status not publicly documented.
Described as good producer in 1991-94 tests alongside well 1. No later well-specific public record found.

India's first CSS: commissioned Dec 2018 under Belgrave Oil & Gas guidance; pilot Nov 2018; ~80-90 bopd reported post-pilot at ~1100 m; pilot planned for 2 further wells. Current status not publicly documented.
Vendor (Nakasawa) reports first injection phase completed after 17 days of injection; CSS operations running since April 2022; demobilizing to second well. Vendor source: secondary.
First-ever Fishbones drilling deployment in an Indian heavy-oil reservoir (OIL official Rajasthan Fields page). No production figures published for this well.
